entities.summary: Sâmbăta de Sus Monastery is a Romanian Orthodox monastery in Sâmbăta de Sus, in the Brașov County of Transylvania, Romania. Dedicated to the Dormition of the Mother of God, it is also known as the Brâncoveanu Monastery.
